reason: Both are commercial-stage, FDA-regulated branded specialty biopharmas that sell prescription drugs and earn partner/royalty-type revenue. Akebia is focused on kidney disease (nephrology), selling to dialysis providers and nephrologists. Innoviva's core is a respiratory royalty portfolio from GSK, plus critical care and infectious disease products sold to hospitals and a portfolio of investments. The therapeutic areas and end customers differ, and Innoviva is partly a royalty and investment holding company. So there is only partial overlap in business model and drug-company type, not in product or specific customers.
